-- Insert robot record if not exists
INSERT INTO robot_record (recreg, rects, botcode) 
SELECT 'RF' || md5('RB1055')::text, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'RB1055'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM robot_record WHERE botcode = 'RB1055');

-- Insert robot details if not exists  
INSERT INTO robot_details (botdetreg, mfgnameval, modelseriesval, bottypeval, payloadcapkg, reachmmval, instdateval, fwversionval, ctrltypeval)
SELECT 'RB1055', 'Unknown', 'Unknown', 'N', 0, 0, CURRENT_DATE, 'Unknown', 'Unknown'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM robot_details WHERE botdetreg = 'RB1055');

-- Insert operation record with NULL currprogval if not exists
INSERT INTO operation (operreg, operrecref, totopshrval, apptypeval, opermodeval, currprogval, progcyclecount, cycletimesecval, axiscountval)
SELECT 'OP_' || md5('RB1055')::text, 'RB1055', 0, 'Unknown', 'MANU', NULL, 0, 0, 0
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM operation WHERE operrecref = 'RB1055');

-- Update mechanical_status component_status to DECOMMISSIONED
UPDATE mechanical_status 
SET component_status = '{"status": "DECOMMISSIONED"}'::jsonb
WHERE mechdetref = 'RB1055';

UPDATE robot_details 
SET fwversionval = '3.4.0'
WHERE modelseriesval = 'Series_892' 
AND botdetreg IN (
    SELECT rd.botdetreg 
    FROM robot_details rd 
    LEFT JOIN operation o ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref 
    WHERE rd.modelseriesval = 'Series_892' AND o.apptypeval IS NULL
);

-- Update application type to 'Standby' for Series_892 robots with no application assigned

SET apptypeval = 'Standby'

    SELECT rd.botdetreg 
    FROM robot_details rd 
    LEFT JOIN operation o ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref 
    WHERE rd.modelseriesval = 'Series_892' AND o.apptypeval IS NULL
);
